title: Mark Simons
intro:
Mark Simons is a judge for Division 5 of the California 1st District Court of Appeal. He assumed office in 2001. His current term ends on January 4, 2027.
Simons is running for re-election for the Division 5 judge of the California 1st District Court of Appeal. He is on the ballot in the retention election on November 3, 2026.
Simons was appointed by former Governor Gray Davis and took the oath of office on January 29, 2001.
